firstContext: 💛 You hold Home key. The key never leaves your pocket. Locks are a promise: somewhere, a door still fits this. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they know your hands. The feast was the weapon.
Travel 1 tile to thicket.
Something moves out there — The Cancellation.
👁️ Rebecca freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🗣️ Onni to Yuki, by the fire: "Stone. We need 46 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "TONIGHT: WHY DO THEY EAT?. Cook for the aliens. They are horrified. The audience is delighted."
📺 SYSTEM: "The cameras want a new face. Wei — the galaxy is about to learn your name."

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 8,2. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: 🌙 Watchers at the northeast treeline see torchlight moving in Thornfield's camp — and it going dark. Whatever was coming, the doubled watch turned it. The night stays quiet, and everyone at the fire understands why.
🌪️ THE HERALD fed in the night — 1,100 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.

📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 8,2. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
🌪️ THE FINALE struck Emberhold in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
— DAY 88 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (19/13/8), with 4 wave-4 and 1 wave-5 fought, 6 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 19 · Craft 7 · Talk 12 · Explore 30 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Ella Johnson ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,029 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
